title: Okuva Mu Buziba bw’Oluzzi
intro: Olugendo lw’omwoyo omuto lwatandika n’okwolesebwa okw’amaanyi okw’ebintu eby’omu ggulu nga bifukamira mu kitiibwa. Obulamu bw’omuntu ono bwalimu okulya mu nsi olukwe olw’amaanyi okuva eri abo abaali ku lusegere, ne baddirira okumala emyaka mingi ng’afuuliddwa mu buddu n’okusibwa mu bukyamu. Naye okuyita mu kukkiriza okutakyukakyuka n’obulagirizi obw’obwakatonda, omuwendo guno gwasituka okuva mu kinnya ekisinga wansi n’afuuka omu ku bantu abasinga amaanyi mu bwakabaka obunene. Osobola okubikkula omuddu wa Allah ono ow’ekitalo?
clues: Nalagibwa okwolesebwa kw’emmunyeenye kkumi na emu, enjuba n’omwezi nga bivunnama mu maaso gange
Nnali mwana muzadde wange gwe yali ayagala ennyo, ekyaleeta obuggya mu baganda bange
Baganda bange ne bankwata, ne banzigyamu ekyambalo kyange, ne nsuula mu luzzi oluzito era olw’ekizikiza
Natundibwa ng’ekintu eky’amaguzi mu katale ne bantwala wala okuva mu nsi yange
Omukazi ow’amaanyi yagezaako okukosa ekitiibwa kyange, era nnasuulibwa mu kkomera olw’okugaana okugenda mu maaso
Naweebwa omukisa n’ekirabo ky’okuvvuunula ebirooto, ne nsituka okuva mu musibe eyeerabirwa ne nfuuka minisita omukulu ow’e Misiri

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
